name: numeric-conversion-test-6b3e1e5e00/invalid-decimal-as-byte-union-negative-255-p.bal
spec_references: Module-level declarations: Type definition; Function definition; Supports required-params
Expressions: Type cast expression; Literal — Currently support `nil-literal`, `boolean-literal`, `numeric-literal` and `string-literal` only
reason: The case expects a panic when decimal -255.0, held in an Employee|string|decimal union, is cast to byte|Employee. Numeric literals, unary minus, local declarations, function calls and type casts are supported, with no restriction excluding union casts, record types or decimal-to-byte cast failure. The out-of-range negative value cannot become a byte or Employee, so the asserted cast panic is within supported behavior.
test_design_notes: The @panic comment marks the expected failure at the cast; no explicit panic statement is needed.
